findings.description: yaml.load(request.data) uses PyYAML unsafe loader, which is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution (CVE-2017-18342) via crafted YAML payloads. An attacker can exploit this endpoint to execute OS commands on the server.

The /proxy endpoint accepts an arbitrary URL from user input and fetches it server-side (requests.get(url)), enabling SSRF. An attacker can target internal services, cloud metadata endpoints, or other restricted network resources.

The pinned dependencies contain known critical vulnerabilities: flask 0.12.2 (CVE-2019-1010083 DoS), requests 2.19.0 (CVE-2018-18074 credential leak on redirect), pyyaml 3.13 (CVE-2017-18342 RCE), and jinja2 2.10 (CVE-2019-10906 sandbox escape). These should be upgraded to patched versions.
